an3.18:1.1: sace vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:
an3.18:1.2: devalokūpapattiyā āvuso samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti?
an3.18:1.3: nanu tumhe bhikkhave evaṃpuṭṭhā aṭṭīyeyyātha, harāyeyyātha, jiguccheyyāthāti?
an3.18:1.5: iti kira tumhe bhikkhave dibbena āyunā aṭṭīyatha, harāyatha, jigucchatha, dibbena vaṇṇena - dibbena sukhena - dibbena yasena - dibbena ādhipateyyena, aṭṭīyatha, harāyatha, jigucchatha.
an3.18:1.6: pageva kho pana bhikkhave tumhehi kāyaduccaritena aṭṭīyitabbaṃ, harāyitabbaṃ, jigucchitabbaṃ. vacīduccaritena …pe… manoduccaritena aṭṭīyitabbaṃ, harāyitabbaṃ, jigucchitabbaṃ.
